tasks.story: Implement PII encryption, SSN masking, and audit logging for credit operations
acceptance: SSN field encrypted at rest using field-level encryption
SSN masked in UI displays (format: ***-**-1234)
SSN masked in all log outputs
AuditEvent model created with immutable=True for credit_consent and credit_pull events
Access logs capture user, timestamp, and action for all credit data reads
Unit tests verify masking in logs and UI serializers

tasks.story: Create CFPB-compliant credit consent modal with 45-day rate-shopping disclosure
acceptance: Modal component blocks credit pull flow until user accepts
Copy includes CFPB 45-day rate-shopping window language
Acceptance triggers AuditEvent.credit_consent log entry
User consent timestamp stored in borrower profile
Unit test verifies modal cannot be bypassed
E2E test confirms consent flow before credit pull

tasks.story: Build credit parser to normalize tri-merge data into Liabilities model
acceptance: Parser ingests mock tri-merge JSON format
Outputs normalized Liabilities with fields: creditor, balance, payment, DLA, lates_24mo, lates_36mo
Flags: is_ibr_deferred, is_cosigned, payment_count_under_10
Handles tradelines, inquiries, and remarks
Unit tests cover 3 sample credit reports (clean, moderate issues, complex)
API endpoint: POST /api/credit/parse returns structured output

tasks.story: Display Credit Snapshot with per-debt confirmation cards and actions
acceptance: Snapshot view shows: credit scores (TU/EQ/EX), tradelines list, inquiries count
Each debt card displays: creditor, balance, payment, status
Card actions: Confirm / Dispute / Upload Documentation
Actions trigger DocTask creation for dispute or upload
Confirmation state persists in borrower profile JSON field
E2E test: view snapshot, confirm 2 debts, dispute 1, upload doc

tasks.story: Create DocTask model with CRUD API and status workflow
acceptance: DocTask model: task_type, status (requested/received/approved/rejected), related_object (Liability FK), assignee, due_date
API endpoints: POST create, GET list/retrieve, PATCH update status
Status transitions logged to AuditEvent
RBAC: borrowers see own tasks, admins see all
Minimal admin UI: list view with filters by status and borrower
Unit tests for state transitions and access control

tasks.story: Add mortgage-specific prompts and badges for forbearance/modification/transfer/foreclosure
acceptance: Prompt dialogs appear when mortgage account detected (account_type=mortgage)
Questions: forbearance status, loan modification, transfer/assumption, foreclosure history
Badges render on Mortgage card with tooltip explanations
Responses saved to borrower profile mortgage_flags JSON field
Badges styled with MUI Chip: forbearance=warning, foreclosure=error, modification=info
Unit test: mortgage detection triggers prompts

tasks.story: Extend User model with BorrowerProfile for credit and mortgage metadata
acceptance: BorrowerProfile model: user FK, credit_consent_at, credit_scores JSON, mortgage_flags JSON, confirmation_state JSON
API endpoints: GET /api/borrower/profile, PATCH update
Profile auto-created on first credit consent
JSON fields validated with JSONSchema
Migration creates profile for existing users
Unit tests for profile CRUD and validation

tasks.story: End-to-end test for complete credit intake flow
acceptance: Test script: login -> consent modal -> mock credit pull -> view snapshot -> confirm debts -> create doc task
Verifies AuditEvent entries created at each step
Confirms borrower profile updated with consent and confirmation state
Validates DocTask created from dispute action
Runs in CI pipeline
Documents test data setup in tests/fixtures/credit_scenarios.json
